propositions: The scrub_bridge_state helper removes .bridge_state* artifacts before run_ensures, but the projects-seed ensure unit unconditionally re-creates .bridge_state/projects.json when its tree-check fails, resurrecting the removed cache during convergence.

The store-copy isolation test fails with AssertionError: binding/snapshot artifacts survived the scrub: ['.bridge_state'] because run_ensures() is called after the initial scrub, re-creating the artifact.
A committing re-scrub of the entire .bridge_state* glob after run_ensures will remove the resurrected artifacts from both worktree and tickets tree while preserving the .env-id store marker.

A fast unit regression test in test_dc_store_copy_fetch_diagnostics.py drives the real seed_projects_mapping_unit as a negative control and validates the post-converge scrub leaves no .bridge_state* files.
